Customer, address and transaction records are public synthetic examples. Source records carry real ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 signatures from an industry-academia sample issuer key. The signatures are checked against the bundled sample public key; they are not KODA signatures or evidence of a real blockchain event. No private signing key is distributed. Output checksums are not sender-authentication signatures. Full public synthetic source records remain in exported files; display-field selection is not confidentiality or zero-knowledge proof.

Product film: One 30-second visualization of address, source and transaction verification followed by receiving-side verification. Interface graphics use the project's actual sample verification results. No interview footage is reproduced. Public research sources are linked in the page. Signed sample records: assurance-fixtures.json; trusted sample public key: assurance-keyring.json.
Product icons: Tabler Icons, pinned commit a4ce1404bc6d24d3c365afe7b258d6bf6f48d62d, Copyright (c) 2020-2026 Paweł Kuna, MIT. Full notice: licenses/tabler-icons-LICENSE.txt. Original KODA logo is preserved; Workspace is a proposed product name for this industry-academia demonstration.

Film music: Suno v6, KODA — 확인은 정확하게. Source: https://suno.com/song/4da01209-cfbf-41e5-a0e1-730781176813 . Volume, brief volume reductions at visual verification cues, and fades edited for the 30-second film; no additional samples or sound effects. Full music attribution: AUDIO-CREDITS.txt.

Current Korean product/video font: Pretendard Variable v1.3.9, Copyright (c)2021 Kil Hyung-jin. SIL Open Font License1.1. Source: https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard/tree/5c41199ea0024a9e0b2cb31735265056e5472d76 . Full notice: licenses/Pretendard-OFL.txt.
Original custody-core brand illustration: created for this project with the built-in image_gen tool. No Circle or Apple logo, product photograph or artwork is reproduced. The original KODA logo is unchanged.
Custody-object motion: Higgsfield Seedance 2.5, generated from the project's original custody-core illustration. Generation job: dee90777-90c4-4c5a-8e1c-38a3adfdd321. The generated clip contains no narration or soundtrack.
